{
  "improvements": [
    {
      "id": "IMP-001",
      "description": "Resolve canonicalization inconsistency by replacing all remaining `jq -S -c` references with RFC 8785 JCS implementation details, commands, and test assertions.",
      "rationale": "The document states v1.2 unified on RFC 8785 JCS, but multiple sections (Software Stack, Data Modeling, Appendix) still prescribe `jq -S -c`, which can produce non-JCS output and break signature/hash interoperability across languages.",
      "location": "§2.2 Canonical JSON; §3.3 Canonical serialization; §7.2 test snippets; Appendix A/B",
      "priority": "HIGH",
      "confidence": 0.98
    },
    {
      "id": "IMP-002",
      "description": "Define deterministic time-source and timestamp precision policy for `ts_utc` generation (clock source, monotonic guard, leap-second handling, microsecond formatting, tie-break on same-microsecond writes).",
      "rationale": "Hash-chain and signature validity depend on reproducible timestamp semantics. Ambiguity in time formatting and ordering can cause non-deterministic chains, verification disagreements, and false integrity failures.",
      "location": "§1.4.1 Audit Envelope responsibilities; §3.2.1 `ts_utc` field; §5.2 audit_emit behavior",
      "priority": "HIGH",
      "confidence": 0.92
    },
    {
      "id": "IMP-003",
      "description": "Specify key-loading and trust-store verification behavior in non-interactive CI/cron contexts, including fail mode when offline root verification cannot run and explicit bootstrap path for first install.",
      "rationale": "The SDD relies on offline-root signed trust-store checks at session start but does not fully define how autonomous cron/CI runs verify trust without interactive operator context, creating deployment ambiguity and potential bypasses.",
      "location": "§1.7 Deployment in CI/cron; §1.9.3.1 Trust-store root of trust; §8 sprint acceptance criteria",
      "priority": "HIGH",
      "confidence": 0.89
    },
    {
      "id": "IMP-004",
      "description": "Add explicit replay/duplication protection requirements for audit events (event UUID, nonce or monotonic sequence per log, duplicate write rejection semantics).",
      "rationale": "Hash-chaining protects order/tamper but not semantic duplicates caused by retries/crashes. Without replay controls, the system may record duplicated actions that appear validly signed and chained.",
      "location": "§1.5.1 Audit log write path; §3.2.1 envelope schema; §5.2 `audit_emit`",
      "priority": "HIGH",
      "confidence": 0.9
    },
    {
      "id": "IMP-005",
      "description": "Clarify and normalize tracked path references for trust ledger (currently `.run/trust-ledger.jsonl` vs `grimoires/loa/trust-ledger.jsonl`) and define a single authoritative location with migration rules.",
      "rationale": "Conflicting file paths for a critical integrity artifact create implementation risk, backup gaps, and incorrect startup-failure checks.",
      "location": "§1.3 component diagram; §1.4 L4 responsibilities; §3.7 persistence policy table",
      "priority": "HIGH",
      "confidence": 0.97
    },
    {
      "id": "IMP-006",
      "description": "Add explicit schema and validation rules for machine fingerprint generation inputs, platform-specific fallback behavior, and privacy constraints (what is stored/hashed, salting strategy, collision handling).",
      "rationale": "Current fingerprint definition is high-level and OS-dependent. Without strict normalization, legitimate same-machine runs may be blocked or, conversely, distinct hosts may collide.",
      "location": "§1.7.1 Hard runtime guardrails (machine fingerprint check)",
      "priority": "MEDIUM",
      "confidence": 0.88
    },
    {
      "id": "IMP-007",
      "description": "Define immutable redaction policy versioning and verification so that redaction configuration changes cannot silently alter security posture for future writes.",
      "rationale": "Redaction is configurable per primitive, but there is no signed/versioned policy binding to events. This weakens forensic consistency and complicates audit interpretation over time.",
      "location": "§1.9.3 Data protection; §5.13 config schema (`audit_redaction`); §3.2 envelope `redaction_applied`",
      "priority": "MEDIUM",
      "confidence": 0.84
    },
    {
      "id": "IMP-008",
      "description": "Specify formal recovery safety constraints for `audit_recover_chain` (who can run it, required approvals, forbidden auto-recovery conditions, and evidentiary markers).",
      "rationale": "Recovery from git history is powerful and potentially destructive if misused. Lacking governance controls could allow accidental or malicious rewriting under the guise of recovery.",
      "location": "§3.4.4 Hash-chain recovery; §5.2.3 `audit_recover_chain`; §6 integrity error handling",
      "priority": "MEDIUM",
      "confidence": 0.87
    },
    {
      "id": "IMP-009",
      "description": "Add precise SLO measurement methodology and load profiles for stated latency targets (sample size, warm/cold cache, hardware baseline, CI variance thresholds).",
      "rationale": "Latency targets are present but non-testable without a measurement contract; different environments can produce conflicting pass/fail outcomes and flaky CI gates.",
      "location": "§1.8 scalability targets; §6.4 logging/latency mention; §7 testing strategy",
      "priority": "MEDIUM",
      "confidence": 0.83
    },
    {
      "id": "IMP-010",
      "description": "Define explicit compatibility matrix and degradation behavior for external dependencies (`ajv`, `yq`, `gh`, `gpg`, Python libs), including minimum command variants and startup diagnostics.",
      "rationale": "The SDD includes fallbacks but not a complete runtime compatibility contract. Missing/variant tooling is a likely operational failure mode on macOS/Linux and CI runners.",
      "location": "§2 Software Stack; §6 Error categories (configuration/external-api); §7 CI matrix",
      "priority": "MEDIUM",
      "confidence": 0.86
    }
  ],
  "summary": "10 improvements identified, 5 HIGH priority"
}
